prompt: Never ____ such a breathtaking view as the one from that mountain.
traps: tras 'never' al inicio hay que invertir sujeto y auxiliar
'did' va seguido de la forma base, no del pasado

prompt: No sooner had I sat down ____ the phone started ringing.
traps: 'then' es un adverbio de tiempo, no un conector

point: reporting passive: is said to have
model: Cambridge C1 Advanced – key word transformation
prompt: The castle ____ been built in the twelfth century.
traps: voz activa: el castillo no dice nada
tras 'is said' va infinitivo, no gerundio

prompt: We ____ so much food. Half the guests didn't come.
traps: presente: no habla de algo que ya ocurrió
'mustn't have' no se usa para innecesario

prompt: The board insisted that the manager ____ immediately.
traps: tras 'insist that' se usa el subjuntivo (forma base), sin -s
pasado indicativo: menos formal y cambia el sentido
futuro: no corresponde a una exigencia

model: Cambridge C1 Advanced – key word transformation
prompt: ____ I need right now is a long holiday.
traps: 'that' no introduce una cláusula sujeto así

prompt: ____ for her quick reaction, the child would have been badly hurt.
____ you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.
traps: 'if' necesitaría un verbo conjugado: 'If you require'
'would' no se usa para invertir una condición

prompt: The more you practise, ____ you will become.

model: Cambridge C1 Advanced – key word transformation
prompt: Not only ____ the deadline, but she also exceeded the targets.
traps: al empezar con 'not only' hay que invertir
orden de afirmación enfática, no inversión
inversión con el verbo léxico: no existe en inglés moderno

prompt: ____ in mind that the museum closes early on Sundays.
I would have liked ____ the concert, but I was working that night.
traps: tras 'would have liked' va infinitivo, no gerundio

prompt: ____ hard she tried, she couldn't convince the committee.
traps: 'whatever' va con un sustantivo, no con un adjetivo o adverbio
'despite' no puede ir con una oración

prompt: The plane was supposed ____ an hour ago, but it's still on the runway.
Hardly ____ the house when it started to pour.
traps: al empezar con 'hardly' hay que invertir
sin inversión y en otro tiempo

point: verb + noun collocations: pose a threat
prompt: Rising sea levels ____ a serious threat to coastal cities.
traps: 'give a threat' no es la colocación

prompt: It is high time the government ____ something about housing prices.
traps: tras 'it is high time' se usa pasado con sentido presente
futuro: no se usa en esta estructura
present perfect: no se usa en esta estructura

prompt: I know you think I forgot, but I ____ send you the invitation. Check your spam folder.
traps: tras 'did' enfático va la forma base

prompt: Little ____ that the stranger would change her life.
traps: inversión con el verbo léxico: no existe

prompt: The builders ____, which is why the roof started leaking after a year.
traps: 'cut your losses' es retirarse para no perder más
'turn a corner' es empezar a mejorar
'go round the bend' es volverse loco

model: Cambridge C1 Advanced – key word transformation
prompt: So strong ____ that several trees fell down.
traps: tras 'so + adjetivo' al inicio hay que invertir

prompt: He was ____ to accept the offer because it meant moving abroad.
No matter ____ you train, you can't win every race.
traps: 'what' necesita un objeto, no un adverbio

prompt: You'd better ____ that cough checked before it gets worse.
The project went ahead, ____ the objections of local residents.
traps: 'nevertheless' es un adverbio: no va seguido de un sustantivo
